content.title: About
content.content: Atole de avena is a traditional Mexican beverage made from whole oat grains, water, sugar, and aromatic additions such as cinnamon or vanilla. The drink has a thick, creamy texture and a mildly sweet, nutty flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Atole is traditionally served in cooler weather as a nourishing breakfast.
Oats, the main ingredient, are rich in beta‑glucans that help lower cholesterol.
In Mexico, atole is often topped with fruit purées or nuts.
The word “atole” comes from the Nahuatl “atl,” meaning “water.”
Oat atole is considered more nutritious than its corn‑based counterparts.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Oats provide both soluble and insoluble fiber, supporting healthy digestion and satiety.

items.title: Contains beta‑glucans
items.content: Beta‑glucans help reduce LDL cholesterol and support immune function.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Oats supply B1, B5, and folate, which are essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Moderate glycemic index
items.content: When prepared properly, atole has a moderate glycemic index, beneficial for blood‑sugar control.

items.title: Rich in minerals
items.content: Oats contain magnesium, iron, and zinc, supporting muscle and nerve health.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to oats or the gluten they contain.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Traditional atole is often sweetened; people monitoring sugar intake should adjust accordingly.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Added sugar and dairy can make the drink calorie‑dense, so portion control is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot, garnished with cinnamon, nuts, or fruit purée. It can be blended into smoothies, used as a base for desserts, or substituted for milk in cereals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry oat flakes in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Prepared atole is best consumed within 24 hours; leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 2 days.
